description: This file is a source implementation of a driver for the MAX31855 thermocouple-to-digital converter. It defines functions for SPI communication, reading temperature data, and handling errors, specifically for managing EGT (Exhaust Gas Temperature) sensors in an embedded system.

methods.name: showEgtInfo
methods.description: Displays the SPI state and configuration of the EGT channels.

methods.name: getMcCode
methods.description: Returns a descriptive string for the status code of the MAX31855 reading.

methods.name: getResultCode
methods.description: Interprets the raw packet data to determine the status of the reading, such as OK, open thermocouple, or shorts.

methods.name: readEgtPacket
methods.description: Performs SPI communication to read the raw data packet from a specified EGT channel.

methods.name: getEgtValue
methods.description: Retrieves the measured temperature value from the EGT channel, or returns an error code.

methods.name: egtRead
methods.description: Reads and logs the current EGT sensor data.

methods.name: initMax31855
methods.description: Initializes the MAX31855 driver with logger, SPI driver, and chip select configurations.
